senses.gloss: m. (= בֵּי אִדְּרֵי, v. אִדַּר; v. Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. I, p. 417ᵇ) barn.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 3b:8">Taan. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>מיבעי לבי ד׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) (the strong wind) is needed in the barn (for winnowing).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 73a:10">B. Mets. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>הפוכו בבי ד׳</he> turn around (busy yourselves) in the barn.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113b:17">B. Kam. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>מאן … בבי ד׳</he> he whose grain is found in the barn.—[<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a:8">Ab. Zar. 28ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="D01026"><he>דָּרָא</he> I</cite>.]
